hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.
BOP drills before the job; kill weight fluid or a tested barrier before the tree comes off.

name: Annular preventer
function: The preventer that closes a rubber element inward on any pipe size, or the open hole, by pushing a piston up under it.

tabs.overview: Closed first on a kick because it seals on anything across it, including tool joints; can strip pipe through it with reduced closing pressure.
tabs.engineering: API Spec 16A; element rated for the well fluids and temperature.
tabs.safety: Element wear checked on the function test; closing pressure regulated.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
